DINESH P ACHARYA

Pune | +91- 7259111095 | rpacharya12@gmail.com

Accomplished Business Analyst Investment Banking and Asset Servicing Domain

Summary ▪ An ardent Business Analyst with over 14 years of experience in project lifecycle management including requirement

elicitation, planning, scheduling, tracking, assessment/design, testing, and implementation support Steered the successful roll-out of projects i.e. Cash Handling Project (MFTA), EXP AG Operations Project, and Babel Invalid Items Clearance Project Proven expertise in applications like MFTA/Babel/EMX

▪

▪ ▪ Demonstrated abilities in implementing various systems as per Business needs (as-is & to-be analysis) and reviewing

processes testing scenarios related to UAT and PROD Environments as per business specifications Excellence in reviewing and identifying opportunities & strategies to improve efficiency

▪ ▪ Brought a unique skill set or approach to the table in client engagement across a range of industries and types of projects; openness to new ideas, approaches, challenges, and environments; excellent communication skills, able to engage with end users and stakeholders at various levels

▪ Adaptable, committed, result-oriented, highly analytical, able to investigate, troubleshoot and determine issues at the root cause Specializing in requirement gathering, process transformation, stakeholder management, and project delivery. ▪ Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, translating business needs into functional solutions, and driving process efficiency, cost optimization, and automation.

Core Competencies Business Analysis: Requirement Gathering & Analysis | As-Is / To-Be Analysis | Gap & Impact Analysis | Business

Rules | Use Cases

Asset Servicing / Operations: Transfer Agency | Client Onboarding & De-Boarding | Fund Accounting Interface |

Reconciliation | Settlements

Process & Transformation: Process Optimisation | Automation | Process Simplification | Root Cause Analysis |

Continuous Improvement

Requirements & Testing: BRD / SLD | Test Cases | UAT | Regression Testing | Defect / Issue Analysis |

Implementation Support

Stakeholders & Delivery: Business–Technology Liaison | Stakeholder Management | Transition / Migration | SOPs

| Training | Project Lifecycle Support

Tools: JIRA | ServiceNow | MS Excel | MS Office | MFTA | Babel | EXP AG | TCX | PSF

Asset servicing under Transfer Agency Global Funds Umbrella: (Operations and Business Analysis Role)

Client Onboarding & De-boarding | Client/Account Servicing | Fund Accounting Interface | Funds In | Payments | Cash Management | Settlements | Reconciliation | Investment Funding | Rebates & Commissions | Dividends / Distributions | Trade Processing | Cash & Securities Movements | Asset Management Operations

Recent Career Highlights

SELECTED CAREER HIGHLIGHTS

Led an initiative to reduce recurring Business queries and improve turnaround time, achieving a 5% reduction of eRMs, zero missed deals and 100% straight-through processing; received Senior Management appreciation.

Led an internal application initiative that improved process stabilisation and efficiency, delivering annual savings

equivalent to 4 FTEs (notional).

• Supported an internal application initiative to streamline daily processing and work allocation, delivering annual

savings equivalent to 2 FTEs (notional).

Supported Babel upgrade from Version 5 to Version 6 and MFTA upgrades from Version 3.9 to 4.5 and 4.5 to 5.0.

Part of TA Banking implementation involving a new Banking platform – PSF and TCX.

Trained 8 FTEs, including Ireland Partners, on process-related applications and created/updated repositories used

as reference guides for BPAs.

Participated in Babel Regression Testing – ICON Upgrades.
